title: Perfume and AI: Berlin Packaging and Ininum win award at Luxe Pack Monaco
summary: The packaging solution developed by Berlin Packaging for Ininum's AI-powered smart perfume device won a Formes de Luxe Award in the Beauty Tech category at the 2026 edition of Luxe Pack Monaco. “Beauty tech is opening entirely new possibilities for how consumers interact with products and brands,” said Andrea Ucchino, Design Director EMEA at Berlin Packaging. “With Ininum, our challenge was to create a design capable of speaking authentically to all the worlds converging in this unique... - Industry buzz
